fp32_error_budget.method: oracle.fp32_budget; independently computed before candidate observation
fp32_error_budget.tolerance_policy: 4x propagated absolute budget, rounded up to1e-5, floor2e-5, plus3e-6 relative. Gate/beta budgets directly checked. Working finite accuracy criterion, not a proven MLX transcendental guarantee.

count_semantics.source_entry: actual Python-level calls through wrappers around unchanged source functions
count_semantics.evaluation: one mx.eval per returned compiled step over inputs,g,beta,prior,y,state plus one output/state barrier per complete invocation
count_semantics.fresh_variants: new exec and decorated function objects per normal/mutant/restored variant; keep references until run end; no injected-global patch after compilation

domain: only these finite dyadic input cases; Dk,Dv1..4,B1..2,T1..7,Hk1..2,Hv1..4,Hv divisibleHk; q/k not produced by excluded projections/normalization
mask_scope: ops/update accepts mask; exact caller has no mask parameter and remains unmasked
